aboutGame.title: What is Task Bar Cube?
paragraphs: Task Bar Cube is a desktop idle RPG from DarkRook Interactive. It runs in a compact taskbar window or in fullscreen on Windows, letting your heroes fight automatically while you work or focus on other tasks.

Build a team from five hero classes, collect gear across seven rarities and seven tiers, socket gems, fuse equipment, and develop pets and village facilities. Cube upgrades, endless levels, ACT League boss bonuses, and Prestige carry the long-term progression.

faq.title: Task Bar Cube FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers about Task Bar Cube, from idle combat and gear to Steam chests, ACT League bonuses, and Prestige.

items.question: What is Task Bar Cube?
items.answer: Task Bar Cube is a desktop idle RPG from DarkRook Interactive for Windows. It runs from your taskbar or in fullscreen while heroes fight automatically and progress through gear, pets, village facilities, and Cube upgrades.

items.question: How do heroes and pets work in Task Bar Cube?
items.answer: Task Bar Cube has five hero classes, each with its own combat skill. Hero skills and talent trees shape development, while pets join team building and receive support from the Library and Animal Shelter.

items.question: How do gear upgrades work in Task Bar Cube?
items.answer: Task Bar Cube gear spans seven rarities from Common to Divine and seven tiers per item. Fusion, gem socketing, rarity upgrades, and tier upgrades all improve equipment.

items.question: How often do Steam chests drop in Task Bar Cube?
items.answer: Task Bar Cube awards one Steam chest for every five minutes of play. The listed chest-level rates are 85% for Level 1, 10% for Level 2, 3% for Level 3, 1.5% for Level 4, and 0.5% for Level 5.

items.question: What survives Prestige in Task Bar Cube?
items.answer: ACT League bonuses remain after Prestige in Task Bar Cube. They are earned by defeating rival bosses and stay with your team through the reset.

items.question: Is there a level cap in Task Bar Cube?
items.answer: No level cap is stated for Task Bar Cube. The game describes endless levels alongside hundreds of Cube upgrades.
